lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: The high-luminance clusters are organized into roughly seven vertical columns, with each column containing 3 to 5 nodes. The arrangement forms a curvilinear grid pattern spanning the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting the circular centroids to create high-contrast anchor nodes that define the shark's vertical stripe-and-spot pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by sharp vertical luminance gradients with light-scattering upper surfaces and shadowed lower margins.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Small, high-luminance blobs are sparsely distributed within the first dorsal fin's silhouette, with a specific cluster of approximately four spots visible near the posterior-inferior margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A dark, horizontal linear indentation is visible on the upper half of the first dorsal fin; minor irregular serration is present on the distal trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A complex branching pattern of white lines connects several spot centroids in a 'Y' configuration in the zone immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit.
